title: Hold a plumbing licence
what: Provide plumbing or drainage services only when licensed in that construction occupation.

sources.title: Construction Occupations (Licensing) Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 84(1) (current republication (R72, from 10 November 2026; Construction Occupations (Licensing) Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person— (a) provides a service (whether as an employee or otherwise) in a construction occupation or occupation class; and (b) either— (i) is not licensed in the occupation or class;

sources.title: Construction Occupations (Licensing) Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 7 (current republication (R72, from 10 November 2026; Construction Occupations (Licensing) Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: Each of the following is a construction occupation: (a) builder; (b) building assessor; (c) building surveyor; (d) drainer; (e) electrician; (f) gasfitter; (g) gas appliance worker; (h) plumber;
